components.note: 阝 (city, place) — right-side 阝 is 邑 (city or place), as in 都, 那, 邻; 邮 was a relay post station.
由 (yóu) — same sound — 邮 is yóu, like 由; 由 also sounds out 油 yóu.
讠 (speech) — 讠 is the simplified 言 (speech), as in 说, 话, 读; 语 is language and spoken words.
吾 (wú) — loose hint — 语 is yǔ; 吾 also sounds out 悟 wù.
木 (wood) — 木 is wood and trees, as in 桌, 板, 树; chairs were wooden furniture.
奇 (qí) — near sound — 椅 is yǐ; 奇 also sounds out 骑 qí and 倚 yǐ.
革 (leather) — 革 is leather, as in 靴 boot, 鞭 whip; shoes were made of leather.
圭 (guī) — loose hint — 鞋 is xié; 圭 also sounds out 挂 guà and 佳 jiā.
阝 (mound, steps) — left-side 阝 is 阜 (mound or steps), as in 阶, 院, 阳; 陛 is the steps up to a throne.
坒 (bì) — same sound — 陛 is bì, as in 陛下 Your Majesty.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water and liquids, as in 海, 汤, 酒; 液 is a liquid.
夜 (yè) — same sound — 液 is yè, like 夜 night.
亻 (person) — person radical — 佑 is a person helping another.
右 (yòu) — same sound — 佑 is yòu, like 右; the right hand is the helping hand, as in 保佑.
月 (flesh) — ⺼ is the body radical (月 in 脸, 脑); the top is an upside-down baby, so 育 is giving birth and then raising, educating.
耳 (ear) — a picture of an ear; as a radical it marks hearing, as in 闻, 聪, 聊.
木 (tree) — 木 is a tree, as in 树, 桌, 林; 朵 is a cluster hanging from a branch, the measure word for flowers and clouds.
艹 (grass) — 艹 here is grass over a body 死, with 廾 (two hands) laying it down — burial.
木 (wood) — 木 is wood, as in 桌, 板; 构 first meant framing with timber.
勾 (gōu) — near sound — 构 is gòu; 勾 also sounds out 沟 gōu, 购 gòu and 够 gòu.
衤 (clothing) — 衤 is the clothing radical, as in 衣, 裤, 衬; 裙 is a skirt.
君 (jūn) — near sound — 裙 is qún; 君 also sounds out 群 qún.
钅 (metal) — 钅 is simplified 金 (metal), as in 钱, 铁, 银; 钻 is a drill, then a diamond.
占 (zhàn) — near sound — 钻 is zuān/zuàn; 占 also sounds out 站 zhàn and 战 zhàn.
艮 (hard, stubborn) — 艮 suggests hard and stubborn; 艰 is simplified from 艱, whose 堇 (jǐn) gave the sound, with 又 now standing in for it.
土 (earth) — 土 is earth and ground, as in 地, 城, 块; 坦 is level ground, then open and frank.
旦 (dàn) — near sound — 坦 is tǎn; 旦 also sounds out 但 dàn and 担 dān.
心 (heart) — 心 is the heart, as in 想, 爱, 念; 慈 is a loving, kind heart.
兹 (zī) — near sound — 慈 is cí; 兹 also sounds out 磁 cí.
羊 (sheep) — 羊 is a symbol of good fortune, as in 美 and 祥; 善 is goodness and kindness, together with 口 (words).
罒 (net) — 罒 is a net, as in 罚, 置; 罗 is a net, and is mostly seen in 罗马 Rome.
皮 (skin) — a hand 又 stripping hide from an animal; 皮 also sounds out 披 pī, 坡 pō and 玻 bō.
月 (flesh) — ⺼ is the body radical (月 in 脸, 脑, 胖); 肤 is the skin.
夫 (fū) — same sound — 肤 is fū, like 夫; also in 皮肤.
木 (wood) — 木 is wood, as in 桌, 板, 树; 棒 is a stick.
奉 (fèng) — loose hint — 棒 is bàng; 奉 also sounds out 捧 pěng.
鱼 (fish) — 鱼 is the fish radical, as in 鲨, 鲸; 鲜 pairs 鱼 with 羊 (sheep) — both freshly tasty foods, so fresh.
工 (work) — a left hand 𠂇 with 工 (work): the hand that helps with work; compare 右 on the right.
口 (mouth) — 右 is a hand 又 plus 口 (mouth) — as a memory aid, the right hand brings food to the mouth; 右 also sounds out 佑 yòu.
疒 (illness) — 疒 is the sickness radical, as in 病, 痛, 疼; 痕 is the scar a sore leaves.
艮 (gèn) — near sound — 痕 is hén; 艮 also sounds out 根 gēn and 很 hěn.
禾 (grain) — 禾 is grain, as in 种, 秋; 稳 is firm, steady, like a solid harvest.
攵 (tap, strike) — 攵 marks an action, as in 教, 放; 敬 is respectful behaviour, as in 尊敬.
苟 (gǒu) — sound clue is weak — 敬 is jìng, but 敬 sounds out 警 jǐng.
土 (earth) — 土 is earth and land, as in 地, 城; 域 is a territory.
或 (huò) — near sound — 域 is yù; 或 also sounds out 惑 huò.
王 (jade) — 王 on the left is 玉 (jade), as in 球, 现, 玩; 玻璃 glass was named like a precious stone.
皮 (pí) — near sound — 玻 is bō; 皮 also sounds out 坡 pō and 波 bō.
王 (jade) — 王 on the left is 玉 (jade), as in 球, 现, 玩; 璃 is a glassy stone, as in 玻璃.
离 (lí) — same sound — 璃 is lí, like 离.
钅 (metal) — 钅 is simplified 金 (metal), as in 钱, 铁, 钟; mirrors were polished bronze.
竟 (jìng) — same sound — 镜 is jìng; 竟 also sounds out 境 jìng.
皿 (dish) — 皿 is a dish or vessel, as in 盘, 盒, 盛; oaths were sworn over a sacrificial vessel.
明 (míng) — near sound — 盟 is méng.
刂 (knife) — 刂 is 刀 (knife) as in 到, 别, 利; 判 is to cut in half, so to separate and decide.
半 (bàn) — near sound — 判 is pàn; 半 means half.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women and female traits, as in 妈, 姐, 妒; 嫉 is jealousy.
疾 (jí) — same sound — 嫉 is jí, like 疾.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women and female traits, as in 嫉, 妈; 妒 is jealousy.
户 (hù) — loose hint — 妒 is dù; 户 also sounds out 护 hù.
亻 (person) — person radical — 借 is a deal between people, as in 借口.
昔 (xī) — near sound — 借 is jiè; 昔 also sounds out 惜 xī and 错 cuò.
土 (earth) — a lump of earth on the ground; as a radical it marks land and soil, as in 地, 城, 块, 墙.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 摇 is to shake or rock.
䍃 (yáo) — same sound — 摇 is yáo; 䍃 also sounds out 谣 yáo and 遥 yáo.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海; 滚 is to roll like boiling water.
衮 (gǔn) — same sound — 滚 is gǔn, like 衮.
心 (heart) — 心 marks emotions, as in 怕, 想, 怒; 怨 is a grudge in the heart.
夗 (wǎn) — near sound — 怨 is yuàn.
⺮ (bamboo) — ⺮ is bamboo, as in 笔, 筷, 箱; slips of bamboo were written on, so 签 is a slip or to sign.
佥 (qiān) — same sound — 签 is qiān; 佥 also sounds out 检 jiǎn and 脸 liǎn.
尚 (shàng) — 尚 itself gives the sound shàng to 赏 shǎng, 掌 zhǎng and 常 cháng.
音 (sound) — 音 over 十 — a full piece of music, so a section; 章 sounds out 彰 zhāng and 障 zhàng.
贝 (shell, money) — 贝 is money, as in 财, 买, 费; 赋 first meant a tax to raise soldiers.
武 (wǔ) — loose hint — 赋 is fù.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 汤, 酒; 海 is the sea.
每 (měi) — near sound — 海 is hǎi; 每 also sounds out 梅 méi and 悔 huǐ.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海; 滩 is a shoal or beach.
难 (nán) — near sound — 滩 is tān; 难 also sounds out 摊 tān.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 描 is to draw or trace by hand.
苗 (miáo) — same sound — 描 is miáo, like 苗; 苗 also sounds out 猫 māo.
